scope: TT 1.8 V 27 C and FS 1.65 V 85 C; recorded ideal-source PWL local chain, e0-e3 WN24 driving WN24 only.
formula: tau(R) dy/dt + y = A(WT,R) tanh(g(WT,R) vin(t-delay)/A); A~WT*R, g~sqrt(WT)*R, tau~R
method: 1 ps sampled differential waveforms, 1.5–4 ns settling history; 4–6.4 ns fit/evaluation; separate independent fit per condition. Holdout never used in fit. Each cascade starts only from measured iso waveform; no internal measured stage reset. Crossing and 10 ps aperture slew errors are predicted minus measured.
limitations: Only two conditions; no PVT interpolation or qualification.
Correlated stages and repeated cycles are not independent samples; holdout extrapolates in width and R.
Output scaling uses nominal R, not extracted physical PDK resistance.
No e4 WN32 heavy load, Xout, common mode, upstream impedance, bias feedback, mismatch, noise, power, serializer or pad.
Holdout error is empirical model discrepancy, not a statistical confidence interval or a guaranteed error bound.
No candidate dimensions selected; waveform model does not establish timing or eye compliance.
